name: STICK BATTLES 🍢
desc:
Stick Battles

Step into the sizzling chaos of Stick Battles – a wild PvP brawler where your goal is simple: skewer your enemies!

🔥 Skewer your opponents onto your mighty stick!
🛠️ Unlock a variety of deadly sticks with special powers!
✊ Build your own combat style with different tools and creative strategies!
🎯 Climb the leaderboards and prove you’re the ultimate stick master!

👑 Premium Benefits: +10% Credits
👥 Friend Boost : +10% Credits

😎Join the group for update announcements, and chat with other players!

❤️ Like the game? Show your support by hitting LIKE and adding it to your FAVORITES!
